payload.summary: CP-HARDEN-07 design fixed from current wait evidence: replace release-reason workaround with explicit wait lifecycle states and resume signals.
payload.next_action: Implement WAITING_OWNER / WAITING_EXTERNAL states, enter_wait/resume_wait inbox operations, wait reservations, projection/validation and dispatcher-safe tests.
decisions: WAITING_OWNER and WAITING_EXTERNAL are canonical lane statuses with active_claim=null.
enter_wait consumes a live implementation claim and preserves work_item, prior claim id, checkpoint/resume evidence and resource locks in wait_state.
Waiting resource locks remain reserved so a differently named claim cannot mutate the frozen candidate while physical/external evidence is pending.
Duplicate work_item claims are rejected while any lane wait_state reserves that work item.
Waiting lanes are absent from checkpoint_watch and need no heartbeat/lease.
resume_wait requires an explicit signal_id plus non-empty evidence refs before returning the lane to READY; it does not auto-claim work.
Historical WAITING_OWNER_PHYSICAL release events remain valid history but are superseded for new waits.
evidence_refs: platform-windows-legacy historical release reason WAITING_OWNER_PHYSICAL observed twice
